name: Items 2: the crafted accessories at tier 7 numbers (what jewelry and cloaks to tier 7 are worth from Level 110 on)
why: 54-review-items call 1. The kit wears a tier 3 ring, tier 2 studs, a tier 2 necklace and a tier 3 cloak at every Level from 30 up, because nothing later has a source. This patch gives those four rows the numbers of a tier 7 step on their own ladder (a point a tier for every style: rings 3 to 7, studs and necklace 2 to 7; the cloak takes the unsourced Dawnlit Mantle's 255 steady and 3 damage for every style). Read it at Level 110 and past only: at Level 30 and 60 the same rows are worn, so those cells are not the proposal. It targets the gear bands.
